notes.text: The web browser and YouTube are back — reach them from the apps row and the Web button on the rail.
Play music from YouTube and it keeps going in the background while you use the console.
An on-screen keyboard for typing web addresses with the controller — press up from the browser's start screen.
YouTube and the browser now run independently, so opening the browser no longer stops your music.
Ordinary websites no longer load in a stretched TV layout.
